source_data.safety_note: Industrial supply with accessible screw terminals; not a user-ready corded product, not weatherproof, and not a venue distro. Mains-side enclosure, overcurrent protection, earthing, wiring and installation require application-specific design by qualified personnel. Do not model as a plug-in fixture or treat rated DC output as available without that design.
